'''Bill Kafer''' (forum TacoBill; DeckTech handle '''TacoBill''', GEMP handle '''TacoBill''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref><ref name="dt-24142">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24142 LSC TacoBill style], DeckTech (Bill "TacoBill" Kafer, 27 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24142/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24142/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009062755/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24142/ Wayback Machine].</ref> is a member of [[New Allies]]. He played Players Committee constructed events. He posted a [[Dark]] [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Let Them Make The First Move]] list on DeckTech (''LSC TacoBill style'').
